{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Ghost| type2=Flying| trainername=Fantina | pokemonname=Drifblim | jtrainername=メリッサ | jpokemonname=フワライド | tmtrainername=Melissa | tmpokemonname=Fuwaride | image=[[File:Fantina Drifblim.png|230px]] | caption=Drifblim in {{aniseries|PTS}}| location=[[Sinnoh]] | gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed female in Pokémon Adventures}} | ability={{a|Aftermath}}{{tt|*|Confirmed in Pokémon Adventures}} | evolution=1 | egg=egg | numepsh=an unknown amount of | firststagename=Drifloon | secondstagename=Drifblim | numeps1=less than 1 | epnum=DP093 | epnametiming=Prior to| epname=Playing The Leveling Field! | eggep=DP093 | eggnametiming=Prior to| eggname=Playing The Leveling Field! | eggmet=[[Sinnoh]] | firstevoep=DP093 | firstevoname=Playing The Leveling Field! | prevonum=425 | evo1num=426 | current=[[Party|With Fantina]] | enva1=[[Michele Knotz]] | enva2=[[Michele Knotz]] | java1=[[Miyako Itō]] | java2=[[Miyako Itō]] | }} '''Fantina's Drifblim''' (Japanese: '''メリッサのフワライド''' ''Melissa's Fuwaride'') is one of [[Fantina]]'s Pokémon in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Drifblim is Fantina's main Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}}. It was hatched from an {{pkmn|Egg}} prior to the start of the series. [[File:Fantina and Drifblim.png|thumb|220px|left|Drifblim and Fantina]] Drifblim first appeared as a {{p|Drifloon}} in ''[[DP093|Playing The Leveling Field!]]''. It was the only Pokémon Fantina used in an unofficial {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}} despite it being three-on-three. Its first opponent was {{AP|Buizel}}. Drifloon was easily able to dodge Buizel's {{m|Water Gun}} and countered with {{m|Ominous Wind}}. After getting hit by {{m|Aqua Jet}}, Drifloon turned the tables by putting Buizel to sleep. Drifloon then notably lifted the sleeping Buizel up in the air, despite his far greater weight, and finished him off with {{m|Psychic}}. {{AP|Chimchar}} was the next opponent Drifloon battled. Chimchar started with {{m|Flamethrower}} which was countered by Psychic. Drifloon then used Will-O-Wisp on Chimchar which successfully made contact. Drifloon used {{m|Hypnosis}} which put Chimchar to sleep, causing Ash to recall it. During Drifloon's battle against {{AP|Pikachu}}, it once again used Will-O-Wisp where it was able to make contact with Pikachu. Pikachu responded with {{m|Thunderbolt}}, which Drifloon shook off. Drifloon used Ominous Wind and clashed with Pikachu's {{m|Volt Tackle}}. Drifloon's Ominous Wind stopped Pikachu's Volt Tackle. However, Pikachu used Thunderbolt once more and easily made contact. The impact caused Drifloon to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Drifblim}}. It used its newfound speed to dodge Pikachu's Thunderbolt and put him to sleep, forcing Ash to forfeit. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous]]'', where Ash recalled the time it put Pikachu to sleep. Ash officially challenged Fantina to a [[Gym]] battle in ''[[DP102|Shield with a Twist!]]''. She called Drifblim out as her final Pokémon where it went up against Pikachu. After Pikachu hit Drifblim with Thunderbolt, Drifblim used Psychic to control Will-O-Wisp and make it rotate rapidly around its body, improving Ash's own [[Counter Shield|shielding strategy]] he had tried to use against her. Drifblim used the Counter Shield strategy to render Pikachu's Thunderbolt useless. It used the strategy again to prevent Pikachu from moving and used another strategy by coming in close and grabbed the opponent, then executing Hypnosis at point-blank range. Pikachu was then finished off with Ominous Wind. Buizel went up next and Drifblim used the Counter Shield strategy again to negate Buizel's Water Gun but it didn't work. Drifblim then used Will-O-Wisp while Buizel used {{m|Water Pulse}}, both attacks clashed which threw Buizel off guard. This gave Drifblim a chance to use the same strategy that it used on Pikachu to put Buizel to sleep. Buizel was then finished with Psychic. Ash's Chimchar was up in the final match. Drifblim used Will-O-Wisp to cancel out Chimchar's {{m|Flame Wheel}}. As the shield was made of Will-O-Wisp and Psychic, and Will-O-Wisp was a {{type|Fire}} move, this gave Ash an idea. He had Chimchar use Flamethrower so that Drifblim can use Counter Shield. Chimchar was able to overpower and destroy Drifblim's shield, with Drifblim getting hit by Chimchar's purple-colored Flamethrower and the power of its own Will-O-Wisp. Drifblim attacked with Ominous Wind but Chimchar evaded with {{m|Dig}}. Chimchar leaps up, grabs Drifblim, and slams it to the ground. Chimchar then ultimately defeats Drifblim with Flamethrower, earning Ash the {{badge|Relic}}. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', when Ash was recalling the time he got the Relic Badge from her. Drifblim also briefly appeared alongside Fantina during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Drifblim appears to be Fantina's favorite Pokémon as her designs are made after it. Drifblim, as a Drifloon, can easily shake off any attack regardless of type during battle. Drifblim can either shoot the flames as an attack or keep the fireballs around it as a defense tactic. |} ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== Unlike in the {{pkmn|animation}}, Drifblim is not Fantina's main Pokémon in her battles; she doesn't even use her (even as a {{p|Drifloon}}) in her official Gym battle against the {{player}} in {{game|Platinum}}. She also serves as Fantina's mean of transportation (and also {{adv|Diamond}}'s and {{adv|Pearl}}'s for a time), being {{m|fly|used as a hot air balloon}}. She was first seen in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'', being used to leave the Contest Hall in [[Hearthome City]] when Fantina sensed a looming presence (actually [[Paka and Uji]]), and she later reappeared in ''[[PS370|Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone III]]'', where Fantina managed to save {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} after the group was attacked by [[Cyrus]] in [[Celestic Town]]. Drifblim was later used in ''[[PS372|Mirages of Mismagius I]]'', battling in {{adv|Platinum}}'s Gym battle against Fantina where it was defeated by her {{TP|Platinum|Empoleon}}'s {{m|Blizzard}}, which froze her {{m|Ominous Wind}}. As Platinum's party needed a quicker means to reach [[Canalave City]], Drifblim was lent to them for an aerial route. When Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum split up to stop [[Team Galactic]]'s attacks on [[Sinnoh]]'s three lakes, however, Drifblim remained with Diamond and was used against [[Mars]] at [[Lake Verity]]. Though she suffered heavy damage at the hands of Mars' {{p|Yanmega}} and [[Mars' Purugly|Purugly]], Drifblim was able to help Diamond reach and infiltrate Team Galactic's air shuttle and was consequently split. She was eventually taken to Pearl by [[Johanna]] at [[Pastoria City]], alongside [[Tru]] and [[Kit]] and was used during the final battle at [[Spear Pillar]], where she attempted to pull her Trainer away from a [[Distortion World|hole]] created by {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}'s battle. The force of the hole's vacuum overpowered Drifblim, but she and Fantina were rescued by [[Reg|Regigigas]] before they could be sucked inside. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ghost|flying|Fantina Drifblim {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Fly|1=Ominous Wind Adventures}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Fly|1=Ominous Wind}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Fly|PS352|Crowded by Croagunk & Advanced on by Abra I}} {{anmov|Ghost|Ominous Wind|PS372|Mirages of Mismagius I}} {{anmov|Ghost|Astonish|Diamond & Pearl chapter (Adventures)|Unknown{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Gust|Diamond & Pearl chapter (Adventures)|Unknown{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[File:Fantina Drifblim DPA.png|thumb|195px|Drifblim in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] Drifblim first appeared in ''[[DPA11|The Legendary Pokémon Appears!]]'' where it was fighting Team Galactic along with the other Gym Leaders' Pokémon. In ''[[DPA22|Bonds Connect Across Space-Time...]]'', Drifblim fought alongside the Gym Leaders' Pokémon against {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} to protect [[Hareta]]. It was overpowered by the two Legendary Pokémon at first. With quick thinking on [[Cyrus]] and Hareta's part by forcing Dialga to use {{m|Roar of Time}}, Drifblim was given the chance for a group attack which sent both Dialga and Palkia back into their own world. {{-}}{{-}} ==Trivia== * Drifblim is the only Pokémon in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to have used the move {{m|Ominous Wind}}. ** It is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{ghost color}}; border: 3px solid #{{flying color light}}" |- !Language !Name !Origin |- style="background: #FFF;" | Japanese | ばるん ''Barun'' | From ''balloon'' |- style="background: #FFF;" | English | Loony | From ''balloon'' |- style="background: #FFF;" | German | Drifzi | From ''Drifzepeli'', Drifblim |- style="background: #FFF;" | Italian | Blimby | From ''Drifblim'' |- style="background: #FFF;" | Spanish | Globor | From ''globo'', balloon |} ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Drifloon|Drifblim}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Drifblim}} [[Category:Gym Leaders' Pokémon]] [[Category:Female characters (Pokémon)|Drifblim]] [[Category:Diamond and Pearl characters]] [[Category:Platinum characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl characters]] [[Category:Animated series Pokémon hatched from Eggs]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Pokémon DP Adventure characters]] [[Category:Nicknamed Pokémon]] [[es:Drifblim de Fantina]] [[fr:Grodrive de Kiméra]] [[it:Drifblim di Fannie]] [[zh:梅麗莎的隨風球]]
